name: GetEmails
description: Retrieves email messages from a specified mailbox folder using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox to retrieve emails from.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The display name of the folder to retrieve emails from. For example, 'Inbox' or 'Sent Items'.

fields.name: UnreadOnly
fields.label: Unread Only
fields.description: If true, returns only unread emails.

fields.name: OnlyWithAttachments
fields.label: With Attachments Only
fields.description: If true, returns only emails that have attachments.

fields.name: IncludeAttachments
fields.label: Include Attachments
fields.description: If true, includes attachment details in the results. Note that this does not return the actual attachment content, but rather metadata about the attachments.

fields.name: Top
fields.label: Top
fields.description: Number of emails to retrieve for pagination.

fields.name: Skip
fields.label: Skip
fields.description: Number of emails to skip for pagination.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the list of email messages from the specified folder, including metadata such as subject, sender, received date, and optionally attachment details.
